english: The amendment facilitates the determination of the electoral constituency of Hirimaradhoo residents for the Local Council Elections and Women’s Development Committee Elections 2026, scheduled for 4 April 2026. As the resettlement is ongoing during the election period, Section 8(h) of the Elections General Act (Act No. 11/2008) applies, which provides that where the inhabitants of an island are in the process of being resettled to another island, such persons shall be deemed to be electors of the island to which they are being resettled.
